title: Don't Count
summary: On Day ten, Maya steps onto the glass skybridge toward Calder Tower.

beats.text: The elevator stopped at thirty. The doors opened onto the skybridge, and the boy was gone.
Glass, rain and the whole city under my shoes. Twenty-three steps to Calder Tower.
Dev limped behind me, humming. "Don't count, Maya. Just walk."
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: I counted anyway. Eight. Nine. The glass gave a thin, bright crack.
Far below, one by one, faces tilted up toward my footsteps.
Ruth texted: Hum, don't count. Numbers make a sound they can hear.
lines: Numbers make a sound they can hear.

beats.text: So I hummed Dev's old song, and the faces below lost interest.
At the end stood a steel door with no handle, only a number inked on it: forty-one.
I put my palm flat on it. Someone knocked back. Slowly. Forty-one times.
